opening.argument: The presentation directly solicits paid participation in BitClub mining pools, with the description promising viewers they can “Get PAID DAILY” by buying in and the speaker identifying a $3,500 founder pool plus a $99 membership fee. The offer is paired with the representation that viewers can “withdraw your money every day” after signing up, while other claims describe balances of $12,000 to $14,000 and potentially hundreds of thousands of dollars from increased Bitcoin holdings. The solicitation also extends to recruitment: signing someone up allegedly produces immediate and daily payments, and viewers are urged to “get involved.” The supplied pool display reinforces that viewers are being shown purchasable mining packages. Although the speaker advises diversification, that qualification does not remove the direct purchase solicitation, recurring-payment claims, or easy-return representations.
